map.credit: Map: Activision Hajin DMZ Tac Map

categories.name: Fortresses
categories.blurb: A Fortress: a heavily guarded stronghold with tougher enemies and better loot.

categories.name: Compounds
categories.blurb: An enemy Compound: a fortified military position inside a normal building, with a guard force and loot to match.

categories.name: Lieutenant Towers
categories.blurb: Climb a Lieutenant Hunt tower to reveal the nearest Lieutenant boss on your map.

categories.name: UAV Towers
categories.blurb: Activate a UAV Tower to see enemies on your minimap for a while.

categories.name: Key Rooms
categories.blurb: A locked room. Find its key in Hajin (keys can drop from Lieutenants) and bring it here; the key's description names its grid square.

categories.name: Ammo & Armor Caches
categories.blurb: Ammo & Armor Cache: refill ammo and plates. It goes on cooldown after use.

categories.name: Fire Stations
categories.blurb: Fire Stations are the place for radiation gear and parachutes, which you need for the Nuclear Reactor and high drops.

categories.name: Police Stations
categories.blurb: Police Stations carry military gear, with a locked Armory inside.

categories.name: Marine Gas Stations
categories.blurb: Marine Gas Station: refuel boats here.

markers.name: 14th Political Prison
markers.note: A walled prison on a cleared plateau in the North Korean wilderness. Watchtowers on every corner, barracks on the east side and the main gate to the south. The Citadel Fortress sits inside the yard.

markers.name: Chang-san Air Base
markers.note: A North Korean air base cut into a granite hillside, with an underground bunker bigger than the base above it. Cliffs guard the east side; the woods to the south are the usual way in. The outside is Critical, the bunker Extreme. Lieutenant Bale holds the Tank Depot in the bunker.

markers.name: Deadtown
markers.note: An empty farming town taken over by the army, with toxic rivers to the northwest and east and sewers running under the main buildings. Light resistance and street fights; the two Re-Education Centers hold the better targets.

markers.name: Imjin Farmland
markers.note: Flat rice fields, waterways and rail lines on the southwest border, with the Rice Mill Fortress in the middle. Long sightlines and little cover, so move carefully or use a vehicle.

markers.name: Cheongun Village
markers.note: A gambling town on the Hajin River with border crossings into Russia to the east and west. Expressway No. 1 runs along its south edge. The Heavenly Luck Casino Fortress dominates it.

markers.name: Haneul Nuclear Reactor
markers.note: A radioactive cloud hangs over the whole site and gets worse inside the reactor. Bring radiation gear and a gas mask; Radiation Blockers help. Fire Stations are where to find the gear.

markers.name: Mirae General Hospital
markers.note: Hajin's main hospital, next to a train station with The Grid and the mall to the east. Triage tents and barracks outside, close-quarters fights through the wards inside. Snipers like the woods of Mujin Pass to the south. Also a Fortress.

markers.name: NuriGo Mall
markers.note: A shopping district under the city's towers: police station, clinic, City Hall, a monorail stop and car parks. Three round structures in the main courtyard lead down to a huge dark underground mall (bring NVGs), which is the NuriGO Mall Fortress. Lieutenant Jang-ui camps here. West is High threat, East Medium.

markers.name: Cheonwang Peak Array
markers.note: Hajin's biggest telecom array on a flat summit, now an enemy base. Boulder trails to the west, gentler woods north toward Mujin Pass. The roof has a helipad and long views.

markers.name: The Grid
markers.note: The walled, razor-wired heart of Hajin City: barricaded streets, watchtowers and roaming patrols. Includes Donpyeong Gate, Hanex Bank, the DBN TV tower (the tallest building in Hajin) and the red-roofed Nenshin Tech Complex, which is Extreme threat.

markers.name: Songdo Wharf
markers.note: A quieter waterfront between the reactor and the river, with working train and monorail lines. The La Grande Vie tower is the tallest building nearby; a market, pier, lighthouse and Oamsik Turtle Island are on the coast.

markers.name: Wolves Stadium
markers.note: A ruined baseball stadium with a collapsed apartment tower beside it, an open-air theatre to the north and a police station and bank in the streets around. The edge with The Grid to the north is the dangerous part.

markers.name: Hajin River Heights
markers.note: Battered apartments and narrow shopping streets south of the stadium, rising toward the river's south fork. One apartment block is Compound Echo; Jinseo Park Towers and South Island's comms tower are further south.

markers.name: Hanrim Village
markers.note: Lieutenant Gorani, a ghillie-suited sniper, hunts from the woods above this village.

markers.name: The Citadel
markers.note: A Y-shaped Fortress inside the prison yard: gantries, cell blocks and a furnace, with high-value targets throughout. Easy to get cut off, so learn the layout. Critical threat.

markers.name: Heavenly Luck Casino
markers.note: A multi-floor casino with an underground car park. No power, so the gambling halls are dark mazes: bring NVGs. High threat.

markers.name: Mirae General Hospital
markers.note: The hospital itself is a Fortress: expect close-quarters fights through the wards and lobby.

markers.name: Admin Complex No. 2
markers.note: The command Fortress at Chang-san Air Base. Extreme threat.

markers.name: Re-Education Center
markers.note: Two central buildings in Deadtown where enemy numbers build up. The town around them has a Clinic and a Gas Station at each end.

markers.name: Rice Mill
markers.note: A Fortress on high ground over the farmland. Use the warehouses as cover on the way in, watch for enemy vehicles in the open, and switch to close-range weapons inside.

markers.name: NuriGO Mall
markers.note: The underground mall beneath the NuriGO courtyard: a sprawling, unlit shopping level. Bring NVGs. The Warden's key opens a sealed door down here.

markers.name: Vault Armory
markers.note: Epic key, grid F4. Opens the small armory in the casino's underground car park.

markers.name: Imjin Mill Foreman's Office
markers.note: Rare key, grid D8. Opens the foreman's office on the first floor of the Rice Mill.

markers.name: The Citadel South Wing
markers.note: Uncommon key. Opens the South Wing of the Citadel inside the prison.

markers.name: Re-Education Center Annex
markers.note: Epic key, grid B7. Opens the annex on the ground floor of the Re-Education Center in Deadtown.

markers.name: Iskra's Control Room
markers.note: Legendary key, grid F7. Opens the control room on the upper floor of the broadcast building.

guide.title: Level unlocks
guide.intro: What each DMZ level gives you, up to level 70.

rows.title: Level 2
rows.subtitle: 3D Printer station; recipes: 1-Plate Armor Vest, 2-Plate Armor Vest, Bandage, Medkit, Small Backpack, Medium Backpack

rows.title: Level 4
rows.subtitle: Reece operator skin; Tacticals print upgrade; Smoke Grenade and Concussion Grenade recipes

rows.title: Level 6
rows.subtitle: Rigid Synthetics x2; Basic Armor Kit

rows.title: Level 7
rows.subtitle: Lethals print upgrade; Frag Grenade and Throwing Knife recipes

rows.title: Level 9
rows.subtitle: Coffey operator skin; Snapshot Grenade recipe

rows.title: Level 11
rows.subtitle: Reactive Metals x2; Basic Triage Kit

rows.title: Level 12
rows.subtitle: Field Upgrades print upgrade; Ammo Box and Spotter Scope recipes

rows.title: Level 18
rows.subtitle: Vendor upgrade: more items for sale

rows.title: Level 19
rows.subtitle: Hector operator skin; Recon Equipment Kit

rows.title: Level 28
rows.subtitle: Fire Support print upgrade; Care Package recipe

rows.title: Level 70
rows.subtitle: +18 Stash slots; 100% Bounty payout; Advanced SERE Kit (Legendary)

guide.title: Crafting recipes
guide.intro: Made at the 3D Printer in your FOB before you deploy. Recipes unlock by level, from DMZ Orders, or by extracting with a looted recipe, which adds it to the printer and pays $5,000. More costs get added as they're confirmed.

rows.title: Medium Backpack
rows.subtitle: 50 Synthetics, 5 Rigid Synthetics. Adds Secure Slots

rows.title: Energy Drink
rows.subtitle: 10 Chemicals, 10 Metals. Unlimited stamina for a while

rows.title: Small Secure Backpack
rows.subtitle: 50 Metals, 10 Rigid Synthetics, 3 Structural Alloy. Three Secure Slots

rows.title: Secure Scavenger Backpack
rows.subtitle: 2 Military Composites, 4 Nylon Laminate, 10 Reactive Metals

rows.title: Tempered Armor Vest
rows.subtitle: 2 Military Composites, 4 Ballistic Fabric, 10 Rigid Synthetics

rows.title: Recon Drone
rows.subtitle: Reward from the Counterfeit DMZ Order. Cost not confirmed yet

guide.title: Resources & ingredients
guide.intro: Loot breaks down by itself into four resources, which take no backpack space. Ingredients stay whole, take a slot and must be extracted.

rows.title: Rigid Synthetics
rows.subtitle: Medium Backpack, Disposable Parachute, Small Secure Backpack, Tempered Armor Vest. Sells for $200. Level 6 gives 2

rows.title: Reactive Metals
rows.subtitle: Industrial areas and toolboxes. 2-Plate Armor Vest, Armor Box, Secure Scavenger Backpack. Sells for $400. Level 11 gives 2

rows.title: Stock Rod
rows.subtitle: Door Breacher Charge, Bomb Glider. Sells for $500. Level 51 gives 2

rows.title: Nylon Laminate
rows.subtitle: Military holdings and upmarket civilian buildings. Secure Scavenger Backpack

rows.title: Military Composites
rows.subtitle: Secure Scavenger Backpack, Tempered Armor Vest

rows.title: Commanders
rows.subtitle: Kill one and extract to get valuable ingredients

rows.title: 3D Printer
rows.subtitle: Crafts gear and upgrades your FOB: Bank and Stash size, MIA rescue discounts, rarer ingredients. Print upgrades: Tacticals (4), Lethals (7), Field Upgrades (12), Fire Support (28)

rows.title: Vendor
rows.subtitle: Sells weapons and items for DMZ Cash. Stock rotates daily; upgrades at 18 and 32 add more

rows.title: Gunsmith
rows.subtitle: Extract a weapon's Manual once, then buy that gun here whenever you like. Base M4 about $5,000, assault rifles $4,750, SMGs $2,850, each attachment slot $1,000. 5% off from level 25

rows.title: Dog Tag Case
rows.subtitle: Stores and shows off the dog tags you've extracted

rows.title: Boss Board
rows.subtitle: Lieutenant intel costs DMZ Cash and lasts one deployment. Commander intel is free

rows.title: Stash
rows.subtitle: Starts at 40 items and 12 weapons, shared by your operators. +18 at levels 22, 45 and 70; +6 weapons at 35 and 60

rows.title: Bank
rows.subtitle: Holds your DMZ Cash; cash you extract goes here. Has a cap that FOB upgrades raise

rows.title: Firing Range
rows.subtitle: Targets from under 10 m to over 100 m

guide.title: Bosses
guide.intro: Lieutenants drop lots of cash, a Dog Tag (picking it up shows your position), sometimes a Key and rarely their weapon. Commanders roam the map; the first kill of each pays cash, and extracting after a kill gives ingredients.

rows.title: Gorani
rows.subtitle: Ghillie-suited sniper in the woods above Hanrim Village

rows.title: Bale
rows.subtitle: Tank Depot in the Chang-san Air Base bunker. Bale's Dog Tag (Legendary) marks you for nearby squads until you extract

rows.title: Jang-ui
rows.subtitle: Camp in the NuriGO Mall shopping district

rows.title: Jin-Tae
rows.subtitle: The target in Operation Critical Extraction. Drops Radiation Blockers. Pays $10,000

rows.title: Scavenger
rows.subtitle: Drops the Scavenger's Dog Tag (Legendary). Pays $10,000

rows.title: Iskra
rows.subtitle: Her Control Room is in the broadcast building at Cheonwang Peak Array. Pays $10,000

rows.title: The Warden
rows.subtitle: Northern hills. Drops a key to a sealed door under NuriGO Mall

rows.title: Colossus
rows.subtitle: A seven-foot armored soldier with a minigun

rows.title: Deathstalker
rows.subtitle: A huge autonomous drone with twin machine-gun turrets. A captured SAM site can shoot it

guide.title: Keys
guide.intro: Keys open locked loot rooms; Lieutenants can drop them. Each key's description names its Tac Map grid square. Locations reported by players, more as they're found.

rows.title: Vault Armory
rows.subtitle: Epic. The small armory in the Heavenly Luck Casino's underground car park, Cheongun Village

rows.title: Imjin Mill Foreman's Office
rows.subtitle: Rare. First floor of the Rice Mill, Imjin Farmland

rows.title: Haksan School Armory
rows.subtitle: Rare. Makeshift armory upstairs in the school northeast of the Re-Education Center, Deadtown

rows.title: Re-Education Center Annex
rows.subtitle: Epic. The annex on the Re-Education Center's ground floor, Deadtown

rows.title: Iskra's Control Room
rows.subtitle: Legendary. Upper floor of the broadcast building, Cheonwang Peak Array

rows.title: Netshin IT Room
rows.subtitle: Epic. The high-security server room on the upper floors of the Netshin Tech Complex, The Grid

rows.title: Traindepot Storage Room
rows.subtitle: Rare. Basement of the train station by the fire station, Cheongun Village

rows.title: The Chemist's Secure Armory
rows.subtitle: Legendary. A secured bunker by the Haneul Nuclear Reactor boathouse

rows.title: The Citadel South Wing
rows.subtitle: Uncommon. The Citadel's South Wing, 14th Political Prison

rows.title: Bank Branch Vault Access
rows.subtitle: Rare. The cash vaults of South Korean bank branches

guide.title: Valuables
guide.intro: Gem-icon loot: sell it for DMZ Cash or put it toward FOB upgrades.

rows.title: Gold Bar
rows.subtitle: Ultra. Also a reward from Silent Ledger

rows.title: Low
rows.subtitle: Imjin Farmland, Cheongun Village, Mirae General Hospital, Songdo Wharf

rows.title: Medium
rows.subtitle: Cheonwang Peak Array, Wolves Stadium, Hajin River Heights, NuriGO East

rows.title: High
rows.subtitle: 14th Political Prison, Heavenly Luck Casino, NuriGO West, Haneul Nuclear Reactor

rows.title: Critical
rows.subtitle: The Grid, The Citadel, Chang-san Air Base (outside)

rows.title: Extreme
rows.subtitle: Chang-san Air Base bunker, Nenshin Tech Complex

rows.title: LTV
rows.subtitle: Random spot. Unlocked by Operation Iron Citadel

rows.title: Helicopter
rows.subtitle: Flown in from the FOB. Unlocked by Operation Grid Assault

rows.title: Dynamic Operations
rows.subtitle: Paid into your Bank per op, plus a Supply Drop that improves with each success

rows.title: Critical Extraction
rows.subtitle: Mirae General Hospital. Get General Kang out alive. Also rewards a Defibrillator

rows.title: Silent Ledger
rows.subtitle: Cheongun Village. Also a Gold Bar and a Polaris Dagor

rows.title: Story Missions
rows.subtitle: Finish a random one three times a week for the weekly rewards

rows.title: Reduce Bounty
rows.subtitle: At a Bounty Station. Four kills make you Wanted

rows.title: Exfil
rows.subtitle: Green smoke marks the helicopter exfils. Call it in and hold the area until it lands. A Fulton balloon or a Flare also gets you out; flares are loud and visible from far away

rows.title: Only extracted loot counts
rows.subtitle: Anything outside your Secure Slots is lost if you don't make it out. Dog tags and bosses' guns only count once extracted

rows.title: Recipes and Manuals
rows.subtitle: Used up when you extract with them: the recipe goes to your printer, the Manual to the Gunsmith

rows.title: Dying
rows.subtitle: Your gear stays in Hajin. A squadmate can rescue you as MIA; the rescue costs more the more Traits you have. Traits are kept

rows.title: Radiation
rows.subtitle: The Reactor needs radiation gear and a gas mask. Radiation Blockers help in irradiated areas

rows.title: 1st Prestige
rows.subtitle: Two Rare weapons, Rare plate carrier and backpack, four Rare ingredients

rows.title: 2nd Prestige
rows.subtitle: Two weapons with four attachment slots, Epic plate carrier and backpack, four Epic ingredients
